items.title: Docker makes Hardened Images Catalog affordable for small businesses
items.description: The Docker team has announced unlimited access to its Hardened Images catalog to make access to secure software bundles affordable for all development teams at startups and SMBs. [...]

items.title: Attackers Season Spam With a Touch of 'Salt'
items.description: Researchers report an increase in the use of hidden content in spam and malicious email to confuse filters and other security mechanisms.

items.title: Google won’t fix new ASCII smuggling attack in Gemini
items.description: Google has decided not to fix a new ASCII smuggling attack in Gemini that could be used to trick the AI assistant into providing users with fake information, alter the model's behavior, and silently poison its data. [...]
